House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to labor; appropriating money to the Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board for certified worker organization grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+NURSING HOME WORKFORCE STANDARDS BOARD; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board for grants to certified worker organizations to assist them in carrying out their duties under Minnesota Statutes, section 181.214. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to labor; appropriating money to the Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board for certified worker organization grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. NURSING HOME WORKFORCE STANDARDS BOARD; APPROPRIATION.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board for grants to certified worker organizations to assist them in carrying out their duties under Minnesota Statutes, section 181.214. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
